critique.evidence: Desktop is polished and cohesive: strong editorial headline, disciplined dark palette, clear cyan/red semantics, and a well-structured replay/detail split. Tablet preserves hierarchy but becomes very tall. Mobile is substantially over-compressed: metadata, labels, evidence copy, and header navigation are extremely small; dense stacked rows create a long, monotonous scan; and the header visibly clips its navigation into a vague “SWIPE” affordance. Contrast verification is also incomplete for 12 mobile header nodes and one tablet node, so visual legibility is not fully proven.
critique.fix: Recompose mobile rather than merely shrinking desktop: increase supporting text and metadata sizes, reduce tracking, condense each transaction into a clearer two-column card, and shorten vertical repetition. Give the header an explicit active-section treatment with a clearer scroll cue, and verify/fix muted navigation contrast on the actual gradient background.
